description: Symbols with unusual options activity on N+ consecutive trading days, with the dominant side (call/put). Persistent unusual flow is a stronger signal than a single print - use for 'where does money keep showing up?'

date.description: Trading day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest available day.

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging; the response reports filtered_total and has_more.

side.description: Dominant side by C/P volume ratio.

name: get_flow_streaks
title: Multi-day unusual-flow streaks (Pro)
